params.body:
The last page of the full report said "Keep it for the deck" and "All 25 pages as a PDF, yours to keep." That read as written to sound like something rather than to say it.

It now says **Download the report** and **The full PDF, 25 pages.**, with the same Download the PDF button.

Tests: 355 passing.
params.title: Report end: plain wording for the download
